_comment: Nutri GraphQL payload for writing Trust Scores & structured properties directly back to DataHub GMS

step1_provision_structured_properties.mutation: mutation createProp($id: String!, $name: String!, $desc: String!) { createStructuredProperty(input: { id: $id, displayName: $name, description: $desc, valueType: "urn:li:dataType:datahub.number", entityTypes: ["urn:li:entityType:datahub.dataset"] }) { urn } }

step2_upsert_values.mutation: mutation upsertProps($assetUrn: String!, $params: [StructuredPropertyInputParams!]!) { upsertStructuredProperties(input: { assetUrn: $assetUrn, structuredPropertyInputParams: $params }) { properties { structuredProperty { urn } } } }

step3_auto_apply_tag_if_low_score.mutation: mutation addNeedsAttentionTag($resourceUrn: String!) { addTag(input: { tagUrn: "urn:li:tag:nutri:needs-attention", resourceUrn: $resourceUrn }) }
